responsibility: Implements an experimental analyzer checker for async-signal-safety violations. This file defines a state_machine with global state for “inside a signal handler”, models registration of handlers via signal() using custom exploded-graph transitions that synthesize later delivery into the handler with a reset region_model frame, maintains a curated set of unsafe libc calls, and emits diagnostics for calls such as printf, malloc, free, or exit that occur along those synthesized signal-handler paths.
